buildRecipe.mode: offline-only once complete dependency lock is reviewed
steps: Verify every declared and transitive input against its immutable SHA256 and byte limit, including base-image closure.
Install only the closed local Debian package set providing Python 3.11, native Tesseract 5.3.0-2, English and orientation/script data, shared libraries and fonts; no apt resolver/network fallback.
Install only the two hash-locked local wheels with no index/dependency resolution; preserve all bundled licences.
Copy document_extractor.py to /opt/luci/document_extractor.py and fixed language data to /opt/luci/tessdata; no user project content in image.
Set exact documentEnvironment, create /input/original mount target, use nonroot default1001:1001; API selects a trusted nonroot owner matching its private original.
Generate and independently review an SPDX/CycloneDX SBOM with hashes, dependency closure and licence notices; record immutable built OCI image ID before configuration.

unresolvedBeforeAcquisitionOrBuild: dependency-lock.json contains174 pinned concrete Debian packages, the88-package base inventory and127 source metadata records;42 unresolved entries mean this is not a closed SBOM.
Authenticate exact Debian controls/source signatures and verify all selected dependency/provider/conflict/version relations.
Resolve13 missing copyright texts and review22 freeform notices; fulfill exact corresponding-source/notice obligations.
Verify pinned wheel native members, compiled dependency subset, feature flags, trained-data/notice member hashes and complete installed-image package set.
Root must review an actual bounded selected builder and exact acquisition/build/acceptance helper; no local effect authorization is present.
requiredActualChecks: Digital-text, scanned, mixed-content, rotated/EXIF, Unicode, encrypted, corrupt and hostile expanded-image/font fixtures on exact image.
Cancellation, restart, lost Create/Start acknowledgement, current-grant revocation, host pressure and positive contained cleanup.
Actual Discover upload -> extract/OCR -> correction -> source-linked Luci questions -> normal context draft/approval E2E.
